title: Week 1 - Setup
description: Learn basic XML, the project structure and the Git workflow. Build with help. Setup notes and one example parse.

title: Week 2 - Baseline
description: Follow parser events and run the assertions-enabled tests. Baseline log with revision, configuration, commands and known failures.

title: Week 3 - Failure reporting
description: How the test runner reports failure; a deliberately failing test (B01, B02). A bounded fix or a precise proposal with evidence.

title: Week 4 - Input matrix
description: Small regressions and 50-100 reviewed W3C cases (G01). An input matrix with reviewed expected outcomes.

title: Week 5 - Regressions
description: Small inputs with different callbacks and chunk boundaries (C02, C03, C10). Repeatable regressions and bug reproductions.

title: Week 6 - One improvement
description: One test-framework or verification-script improvement, with before-and-after results and review.

title: Week 7 - Comparison
description: xpact vs libexpat (A04, G03): a table of matches, differences and untested cases.

title: Week 8 - Consolidate
description: Shared fixtures and comparison output; optional SVG, libxml2 or Core cases.

title: Week 9 - Analyse and draft
description: Analyse the results and draft the report, with result tables tied to specific builds.

title: Week 10 - Handover
description: Final report, tests, code or proposals, setup guide and follow-up list.
